digest.component_or_area: metrics engine - event-derivation readers over durable ticket store
propositions: Read-only metric derivations over durable ticket event store must reuse existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event) for file sorting and retired-event handling rather than reinventing them.

Metrics requiring per-event or multi-occurrence data (attempts_per_ticket, rework_within_days, reopen_recovery) read raw event files; metrics needing only terminal state (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery) read compiled reduce_ticket state.

Attempts_per_ticket counts distinct claim sessions via open→in_progress STATUS edges; rework_within_days identifies closed→open→closed sequences within n days; revert_recovery filters reverts by target_event_type (STATUS/COMMITS only, excluding COMMENT/LINK).
Metrics return None for empty ranges (Unavailable) and 0 for populated ranges with zero qualifying events; registered with source="structural" and confidence="high".

Unit tests must verify: two-session ticket yields attempts==2; 3-day closed→open→closed counts in rework_within_days(7) but 10-day gap does not; STATUS-revert is counted by revert_recovery but COMMENT-revert is not; retired events are included in all counts.
